text:
incident-bot: \ud83d\udd14 Alert: increased 5xx rate from dedicated pool 'dedicated-prod-west-2' ( > 12% ) and queue depth rising. Pager triggered at 2468039999. Paging @oncall_sam.
oncall_sam: ack - joining the bridge. any customer hits?
cs_rachel: NovaTech reported elevated error rates in their ingestion pipeline and extra retries. CSM alerted at 2468040005.
priya: looking at agent metrics now. I see memory pressure and repeated KV cache evictions on nodes in the pool; this correlates with a config change last night that raised max_batch and prefetch concurrency. grabbing logs + flamegraphs.
jason_ops: spun up fallback pool 'fc-warm-2' and started sticky-reroute for a subset of traffic to avoid broad failover. also started draining one suspect host for inspection.
priya: short mitigation plan: 1) cap batch_size to 6, 2) disable prefetch, 3) reduce concurrency throttles for the pool. patches below.
priya: run these internal ops commands (internal-only):
```
# cap batch
POST /internal/autoscaler/modify {"pool":"dedicated-prod-west-2","batch_size":6}
# turn off prefetch
POST /internal/config/set {"pool":"dedicated-prod-west-2","prefetch":false}
# lower concurrency
POST /internal/traffic/limit {"pool":"dedicated-prod-west-2","concurrency":80}
```
oncall_sam: applied batch cap and prefetch off. concurrent requests reduced. CPU and mem dropping on affected nodes. 5xx rate falling to ~3%.
cs_rachel: drafting a one-line customer update for NovaTech: "We detected elevated 503s affecting your dedicated instance in us-west-2. We routed traffic to fallback capacity and applied configuration changes; services are recovering. We will follow up with a full RCA and timeline within 24 hours." Send?
oncall_sam: send it and loop me in. thanks.
cs_rachel: sent to NovaTech and to their CSM. they asked: any risk of missing messages?
jason_ops: no data loss observed in message store and retry logic succeeded for most requests. noted a small window (~3m) where client retries increased.
product-priya: posting short status page update: "Investigating increased error rates for dedicated-prod-west-2. Mitigations applied; monitoring. No confirmed data loss. Next update in 30m."
oncall_sam: posted to status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2468039999. linked the customer note.
incident-bot: incident created, bridge link https://internal.redwood/bridges/2468039999. state -> investigating.
priya: preliminary hypothesis: a memory/regression in autoscaler agent v2.13.9 interacting poorly with higher batch/concurrency defaults -> KV cache thrash and OOMs on host-level; continuing heap profiling and stack traces.
jason_ops: placed host i-0abc123 into quarantine for deeper inspection; collected core dump.
oncall_sam: handoff plan: I'll keep watch for 45m then hand to @oncall_meera. please summarize non-blocking follow-ups.
oncall_meera: ack - will pick up at 2468043600.
priya: metrics after mitigation: 5xx rate back to baseline (~0.8%), queue depth normalized. leaving rollback path in case traces confirm agent regression.
cs_rachel: preparing customer-facing RCA draft with timeline and mitigations. aiming to send within 6 hours once eng confirms root cause.
product-priya: questions for scoping: should we proactively offer SLA credit? NovaTech had ~20 minutes of elevated errors.
oncall_sam: flag billing and ops leads; we should coordinate before promising credits. I'll add to exec note.
jason_ops: filed follow-ups: INT-4399 (agent investigation), OPS-994 (safe-config default caps), CS-2134 (NovaTech RCA & outreach). linking to bridge.
priya: upload: heap profiles + flamegraphs attached to INT-4399. early signs point to increased allocation retention in the agent's cache path under heavy batching.
oncall_meera: added runbook entry: on 5xx surge + kv eviction alarms -> cap batch, disable prefetch, shift traffic to fallback, drain suspect hosts.
incident-bot: status updated -> monitoring at 2468041200.
oncall_sam: drafting internal summary for the post-incident note:
- summary: transient spike of 5xx from dedicated-prod-west-2 impacting NovaTech ingestion; mitigated by capping batch_size, disabling prefetch, and partial traffic reroute to fallback pool; no confirmed data loss.
- timeline (UTC):
  - 2468039999: pager fired for 5xx surge
  - 2468040050: bridge created, oncall ack
  - 2468040120: mitigation commands applied (batch_size=6, prefetch off)
  - 2468040300: traffic reroute to fallback pool begins for subset
  - 2468040900: metrics stabilized back to baseline
  - 2468043600: watch handed to oncall_meera
- suspected root cause: memory regression in autoscaler agent v2.13.9 + increased batch/concurrency defaults leading to KV cache thrash
- action items:
  1) eng-runtime: hotfix/rollback for agent (owner: priya) - INT-4399
  2) eng-platform: enforce conservative safe-configs for production pools (owner: jason_ops) - OPS-994
  3) observability: add KV-cache eviction alert and memory-regression detector (owner: eng-infra)
  4) CS: formal RCA to NovaTech and offer 1:1 technical review (owner: cs_rachel) - CS-2134

cs_rachel: sending internal RCA draft to eng for technical review now. will finalize customer RCA after eng confirmation.
priya: ETA on root cause confirmation and patch plan: 8 hours if we need to bump a patch; otherwise rollback to v2.13.8 within 2 hours if evidence is clear.
oncall_meera: picked up the watch at 2468043600. all systems green on my end. ping me for any regressions overnight.
jason_ops: added a short note to the reliability board for the next post-incident review.
cs_rachel: final customer message sent: "We applied mitigations and your service recovered; we're preparing a detailed RCA and action plan and will share within 24 hours. If you'd like a call, we can schedule one." NovaTech acknowledged and requested the RCA timeline.
oncall_sam: closing bridge in 4 hours if unchanged. thanks team for quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident state -> resolved (monitoring) at 2468047200. archived note created.
cs_rachel: end of thread - moving RCA to CS-2134 and closing after publish.
